identity.title: List of English language Diamond and Pearl home video releases (Region 4)

leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the tenth season of , Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the tenth season of , Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Two Diamond and Pearl Collections were released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in 2009, containing the whole season between them. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl - Collection 1===
 
 
Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl Collection 1 was released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on May 6, 2009. It contains four discs with 25 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DBX13064.

====Contents====
 

===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl - Collection 2===
 
Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl Collection 2 was released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on May 6, 2009. It contains four discs with 26 episodes across them combined, and one bonus disc with Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness. Its catalogue number is DBX13066.

====Contents====
 

==Season 10 disc set==
 

 (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) began releasing DigiPack disc sets of each season in 2010.

The Season 10 DigiPack disc set was released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on March 2, 2011 and in New Zealand on June 16, 2011. It contains six discs with 51 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DBX13192. Its discs are designed to resemble a Heal Ball. The DigiPack disc set was re-released exclusive to JB Hi-Fi online on July 14, 2016 and in JB Hi-Fi stores on September 21, 2016 to celebrate the Pokémon 20th Anniversary. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

This disc set was re-released by Beyond Home Entertainment in a slimline case in Australia on April 2, 2014 with a different cover and the catalogue number BHE5394.

This disc set was once again re-released by Shock Entertainment in Australia on June 2, 2021 and in New Zealand on July 21, 2021 with a different cover and the catalogue number KAL5661B.

===Contents===
Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself. The featured Pokémon appears in at least one of the episodes on that disc, and is typically an important Pokémon in one of them.

==Multi-season releases==
The following are English language Region 4 multi-season releases that include Diamond and Pearl episodes.

Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl - Limited Edition Collection
Pokémon: Heritage Collection II
Pokémon Seasons 1-19: Deluxe Edition
Pokémon Seasons 1-20: Ultra Collection
Pokémon Seasons 1-21: Mega Collection
